_note: Wild work done in person on the inner map (ui/mapTasks/wildTasks.js, systems/wildTasks.js): foraging, hunting, fishing, winter trapping and ice fishing, smuggling and pickpocketing. The rewards stay with the old handlers (player/foraging.js, player/seasonalWork.js, ui/actionMenu); this file holds the wording and the feel of each task. Radii are in inner-map tiles, times in real seconds unless named Hours. {name} style fields are filled in by the task.

prompt.inPersonHint: Do it in person on the map: the better you do, the better it goes.
prompt.quickHint: A plain day's result, no walking.

forage.title: Foraging
forage.say: Gather what you find. Marked patches are plain to see; search near cover to turn up the rest.
forage.nearby: You spot signs of something to the {dir}.
forage.empty: You searched but found nothing of value today.

hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.say: Follow the sign to the {name}. Creep up: walking near it alarms it, standing still calms it. Loose when you are close.
read: A tuft of fur on the thorns.
hunt.bolted: The {name} bolts! It runs a way off and stops, ears up.
hunt.gone: The {name} bolts into cover and is gone.

bow._doc: Shooting game with a bow (player/huntingBow.js; the stalk in ui/mapTasks/wildTasks.js, the quick hunt in ui/actionMenu/jobs.js). Hunting at range needs a weapon of `weapons` (the best grade held is the one in hand: data/craftGrades.json) and at least one of `ammo`; every shot uses one. hit chance = base - max(0, dist - freeTiles) x perTile - alert x alert + clamp(log10(kg / sizeRef) x perSizeDecade, sizeMin, sizeMax) - (fleeSpeed - speedRef) x perSpeed x (0.5 + alert) + the Hunting & Butchering rank (0..4) x perRank + steadiness x perSteady (steadiness: 35 - Hunting.hitThreshold, i.e. combat x 2 + strength + the better of the Hunting and Archery aim; Archery's steady perk counts half) + (the bow's grade effect - 1) x perGradeEffect + the weapon's aim + (the arrow's grade effect - 1) x perArrowEffect (+ wounded when the beast is already hurt), clamped to [min, max]. A hit kills outright on the kill chance (base + rank x perRank + (grade effect - 1) x perGradeEffect - log10(kg / sizeRef) x perSizeDecade + close within closeTiles + wounded on a beast already hit), else the beast is wounded and runs (boltSeconds x woundedBolt) and must be shot again. A miss spooks it (it bolts), unless Archery's second arrow lets you loose again first; after missesBeforeGone misses it is gone. recover: the share of missed arrows that land whole (laid on the ground where they fell, to pick up; the quick hunt fetches them for you) and of arrows pulled whole from a kill (each one in it). wear: each shot adds perShot x the weapon's wear / the grade's effect x (0.5 + a roll) to the bow's wear (out of 100, kept on player.bowWear by bow and grade); at 100 it breaks, and past 100 - snapBelow each shot has snapChance to snap early. fumble: a miss's chance of a slip that hurts you (damage hp). quick: the quick hunt's shots at most, at dist and alert (alert rises by alertPerMiss). Species weight (kg) and fleeSpeed come from data/animals.json species (a quarry with none: defaultKg, defaultSpeed).

words.noBow: You need a bow to hunt game at range: make one at a workbench (wood and sinew or cord) or buy one from a bowyer or blacksmith. Snares and traps need no bow.
words.noArrows: You have a bow but no arrows. Fletch some at a workbench (wood, feathers and a stone or iron head) or buy a sheaf at market.
words.hit: The arrow strikes home: the {name} is down.
words.wounded: The arrow strikes the {name}, but it runs on, hurt. Follow it and loose again.
words.miss: Your arrow flies wide. The {name} bolts.
words.secondArrow: Your first goes wide, but you nock again before the {name} can run.
words.gone: The {name} is gone, and your arrows with it.
words.worn: Your {bow} is badly worn: it may not last much longer.
words.arrowLies: Your arrow lies in the grass where it fell: pick it up.
words.recovered: You pull {n} arrow(s) whole from the carcass.

fish.title: Fishing
fish.say: Go down to the water and cast. When it bites, strike!
fish.quiet: Nothing biting… the water is quiet.
fish.snapped: The line snapped! The {name} got away.
fish.shy: The fish here have gone shy. Try along the bank.
fish.left: You reel in and walk off.

trap.title: Trapping
trap.runSay: Paw prints mark the game runs. Set your snares on the runs, under cover, then walk back round and check them.
trap.setSay: Lay a trap line: set the snares on the game runs, under cover. Where you set them decides what the line takes.
trap.tendSay: Walk your trap line from snare to snare. Only the snares you reach are emptied.
trap.tooClose: You already have a snare here.

setNote.good: A good spot: right on the run, with cover.
setNote.poor: Open ground: little will pass this way.

trap.set: Set a snare on the run
trap.allSet: The snares are set. Walk back round and check them.

iceFish.title: Ice Fishing
iceFish.shoreSay: Cut a hole near the bank and fish through it.
iceFish.farSay: Walk out to where the ice is thin, cut a hole and fish.
iceFish.cutShore: Cut a hole in the ice
iceFish.cutFar: Out on the thin ice: cut a hole

smuggle.title: Smuggling
smuggle.say: Carry the {item} to the fence's door. Keep out of the watch's sight.
smuggle.hand: Hand the goods to the fence
smuggle.seen: {name} of the watch is looking your way!

pickpocket.title: Pickpocket
pickpocket.say: Get close to the {name} and lift the purse while they're not looking. Step back when they turn round.
